limitations: Natural-gas storage alone does not identify demand, weather-adjusted pressure, gas price effects or the European power channel.
Petroleum evidence retained in this package is older than some separately restored collector data; those separate release vintages must not be silently merged.
EIA-origin evidence is shared across related Energy/GEV products and must not be counted as independent corroboration.
The investigation is exploratory: prior domain reports and numerical results were known before these comparisons. No prospective, causal or out-of-sample validation is established.
Retained selections are verified tool representations, not original publisher-body hashes. Connected upstream HTTP requests, bytes and redirects are not exposed.
